subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): scope memory_recall and memory_forget + configurable thresholds

question: Should memory-lancedb accept this scoped-tool API and threshold config now, or should it wait for the broader per-agent/per-channel ambient-memory design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102973?
rationale: The PR adds user-facing tool parameters, plugin config knobs, stored-row columns, and new global-only auto-recall semantics, so the permanent contract needs maintainer intent beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor Scoped Tool Foundation
options.body: Proceed with this plugin-local API after rebase, docs, real behavior proof, and upgrade proof are added.

options.title: Fold Into Ambient Scoping Design
options.body: Pause this PR and design the explicit tool scope together with per-agent/per-channel ambient capture and recall controls.

options.title: Defer The Direction
options.body: Close or defer the PR until there is maintainer demand for scoped shared LanceDB stores.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Scoped Tool Foundation
recommendation.body: Proceed with this plugin-local API after rebase, docs, real behavior proof, and upgrade proof are added.
